[[Taylor Hale]] |TwitterUserName = xaviereprather |InstagramUserName = xaviereprather |FacebookUserName = XavierPratherbb23 | thechallenge = {{otherfandom|thechallenge|Xavier_Prather}} |}}'''Xavier Eugene Prather''' is the [[Winners (US)|winner]] of ''[[Big Brother 23 (US)]]''. He was later a finalist on ''[[Big Brother: Reindeer Games]]''. A member of the [[Kings]], Xavier knew he was in for an intense game in ''Big Brother 23 (US)'', so he started low-key pretending he was a bartender and not talking much strategy with anyone. His likability got him into several key alliances, most notably [[The Cookout]]. As the The Cookout executed its plan to reach the end together, Xavier remained loyal while also protecting his individual position, even after losing key allies and briefly clashing over strategic decisions. In the second half of the game, he became a more visible threat, repeatedly ending up on the block as a pawn but surviving through alliances and competition timing, while also securing multiple Final Two deals. In the endgame, he successfully eliminated major competitors, including [[Kyland Young]], and positioned himself as the most balanced combination of loyalty, strategy, and competition strength, ultimately winning the season in a unanimous 9–0 jury vote as the first Black winner of ''Big Brother U.S.'' Xavier would then return on ''Reindeer Games'' and was consistently targeted by others for being an obvious physical threat. Though he was at the bottom throughout the game, he was able to scrape through and survived all Santa's Showdown challenges he was sent to participate in. Propelling himself to the titular ''Reindeer Games'' finale, he narrowly lost against eventual winner [[Nicole Franzel]]. He ultimately finished in a joint 3rd place alongside [[Frankie Grande]].
